Train your fingers to perform on harder climbs and steeper terrain

This 6-week program is designed to help experienced climbers develop more finger strength. This program is suitable for climbers with a long training history with lots of experience using a fingerboard. This schedule should be carefully planned around your climbing week to maximise recovery between sessions.
